concept.title: The layout
concept.shortdesc: The view has two parts side by side, and a third you can call up:

ul.li: The list — every artifact in the project, as a table or a tree diagram (see below). Above it sit the type tabs, the project search and its filters, and a line of figures for what is in view.

The detail panel — on the right, the selected artifact: its status, quality and priority, its text, its place in the trace and its tests (see The detail panel). Drag its left edge to make it wider; the width is remembered.
Notes — the Chatter panel at the far right: comments on the selected artifact and the V&V Assistant (see Making room).

conbody.p: The header holds the baseline picker and the project actions — Compare, Capture Baseline, Draft test cases, ↓ Download — with one blue button, + New Artifact, at its end.
Help in the top bar (or ? on the keyboard) opens the help panel for this page, with the artifact and link types.
